features.title: Fast polished output
features.body: Use the focused H3 Max route for strong prompt adherence and quick production at 480P or 768P.

features.title: Direct your scene with text
features.body: Describe the subject, action, camera and sound. Choose balanced or quality prompt expansion to develop the scene.

features.title: 5–15-second clips
features.body: Choose any whole-second duration and one of six landscape, square, or vertical ratios for text-to-video.

features.title: Native audio
features.body: Generate dialogue, ambience, music, and synchronized effects with the video.

decisionCards.title: Choose H3 Max for focused speed
decisionCards.body: Use H3 Max when fast 768P production, prompt adherence, and native audio matter more than 2K or 4K delivery.

decisionCards.title: See MiniMax H3 for 2K and 4K
decisionCards.body: Choose H3 Max for fast 480P or 768P production with prompt expansion and strong visual finish. Keep MiniMax H3 for broad 2K/4K delivery intent.
